examples.title: Does it fit on one page?

description: Pagination preview WITHOUT generating a PDF: page count and where every block lands (page, x, top, width, height in points). Same `blocks` as generate_basic_pdf plus every input that moves a block (title, footerText, pdfA, normalize, embedFonts, pageSize, margins, headerTemplate, footerTemplate): pass what you will give generate_basic_pdf and the page count matches — the dry run shares the pagination planner of the builder, toc blocks included. Read-only, deterministic. Token-frugal: verbosity:'summary', fields:['totalPages'].

blocks.description: Ordered list of content blocks composing the document body.

keepWithNext.description: Keep this heading on the same page as the block that follows. Overrides typography.keepHeadingsWithNext for this block, either way.

align.description: Text alignment (default left). 'justify' spans every line but the last across the measure; pair it with typography.opticalMargins.

keepWithNext.description: Keep this paragraph on the same page as the block that follows (a lead-in line before a table or figure). Default false.

splittable.description: Allow / forbid this paragraph breaking across pages, overriding typography.splitParagraphs for this block.

text.description: Paragraph text. Embedded newlines ('\n') are automatically split into separate paragraphs — no need to pre-split; never emit a literal newline expecting a soft line break.

items.description: List items. A string is a leaf; an object { text, items } nests a sub-list (bullets/numbers indent; numbered sub-lists restart at 1).

oneOf.description: Native vector chart rendered as pure PDF path operators — bar / horizontal-bar / stacked-bar / line / area / scatter / pie / donut (pdfnative 1.7 charts v2: time and log axes, data labels, secondary axis, legends). Same body as add_chart.

align.description: Horizontal alignment within the content width. Default 'left'.

altText.description: Alt text for the tagged-PDF /Figure /Alt. Auto-generated when omitted.

scale.description: Value-axis scale. 'log' requires strictly positive values and is not available for stacked charts.

yMax.description: Force the axis maximum (values are clamped to the plot band).

yMin.description: Force the axis minimum (values are clamped to the plot band).

axis2.description: Secondary RIGHT value axis (drawn only when a series sets yAxis:'right').

categories.description: Category / slice labels (x-axis). Defaults to 1-based indices when omitted.

chartType.description: Chart kind. 'pie'/'donut' use exactly one series; 'bar'/'barH'/'stackedBar'/'stackedBarH'/'line'/'area'/'scatter' support multiple series. 'scatter' requires xValues on every series and a positional xAxis.type ('linear' or 'time').

colors.description: Palette override (per-series for bar/line, per-slice for pie/donut).

anyOf.description: DeviceCMYK operands 'C M Y K', each 0.0–1.0.
DeviceCMYK ink percentages [c, m, y, k], each 0–100.

dataLabels.description: Per-point value labels: true for defaults, or an object to format them.

labelRotation.description: Rotate category labels counter-clockwise by this many degrees (disables the automatic stride).

labelStride.description: Draw every Nth category label. Default: automatic (measured non-overlap); 1 draws every label.

legend.description: Legend placement. Defaults to 'bottom' for multi-series/pie, else 'none'.

markers.description: Draw point markers on line series. Default false.

series.description: Data series. Pie/donut charts use exactly one series (each value becomes a slice).

anyOf.description: DeviceCMYK operands 'C M Y K', each 0.0–1.0.
DeviceCMYK ink percentages [c, m, y, k], each 0–100.

values.description: Numeric values, one per category. Negative values are supported for bar/line.

xValues.description: Per-point x positions (same length as values) for scatter charts and for line/area charts with xAxis.type 'linear' or 'time'.

items.description: Positional x value: a number (linear axis) or an ISO-8601 date / epoch milliseconds (time axis).

yAxis.description: Bind the series to the left (default) or the secondary right value axis (cartesian charts only; configure its range with 'axis2').

title.description: Chart title rendered above the plot.

width.description: Plot width in points (clamped to content width). Default 460.

xAxis.description: Horizontal axis. 'category' (default) positions points by index; 'linear' / 'time' position them by series xValues (line/area/scatter only). Time ticks are UTC-deterministic.

max.description: Axis maximum (number, or ISO-8601 / epoch ms for time axes).

min.description: Axis minimum (number, or ISO-8601 / epoch ms for time axes).

oneOf.description: Inline smart table — same body as add_table (every row must have exactly as many cells as headers).

autoFitColumns.description: Auto-fit column widths to content. Output bytes then depend on text metrics (not byte-deterministic across content changes).

caption.description: Caption rendered above the table (tagged as /Caption under PDF/A).

cellBorders.description: Per-cell vector borders (pure strokes, PDF/A-safe). Choose individual sides or `all`.

all.description: Draw all four edges (overrides the individual side flags).

anyOf.description: DeviceCMYK ink percentages [c, m, y, k], each 0–100.

color.description: Stroke colour as a PDF operator string ('0.8 0.8 0.8') or hex. Default light grey.

clipCells.description: Clip cell contents to the column bounds (PDF clip operators). Recommended for PDF/A and visual safety.

headers.description: Column header labels. Must have the same length as each row in `rows`.

repeatHeader.description: Repeat the header row on every continuation page (default true).

rows.description: Data rows. Each row is an array of cell strings with the same length as `headers`.

wrap.description: Cell wrap policy: 'auto' (default) wraps only overflowing cells; 'always' wraps every cell; 'never' truncates.

zebra.description: Alternate-row light tint (static fill, PDF/A-1b safe).

oneOf.description: Inline JPEG/PNG image. Without width/height the pixel size is used as points and clamped to the content width; with one dimension the aspect ratio is kept. The decoded bytes of all image blocks in one call are capped at 24 MiB (a watermark image has its own 8 MiB cap).

align.description: Horizontal placement inside the content width.

alt.description: Accessible description (tagged /Figure /Alt). Always provide it for non-decorative content under PDF/A or PDF/UA.

imageBase64.description: Base64 image bytes. JPEG (baseline; 1, 3 or 4 components — CMYK raises PDFA_DEVICE_CMYK_IMAGE under PDF/A) or PNG (8-bit greyscale/RGB, non-interlaced; alpha-channel and palette PNGs are rejected with a remedy). No data: URI.

mimeType.description: MIME type of the image. Must match the actual encoding of imageBase64 (magic bytes are checked).

oneOf.description: Clickable external link (/URI action). Only http:, https: and mailto: URLs are accepted.

anyOf.description: DeviceCMYK operands 'C M Y K', each 0.0–1.0.
DeviceCMYK ink percentages [c, m, y, k], each 0–100.

oneOf.description: Printed table of contents generated from the document's heading blocks (internal /GoTo links with dot leaders). Pairs with outline:'auto' for the bookmark pane.

indent.description: Points of indent per heading level (default 15).

oneOf.description: Inline barcode — same body as add_barcode (pure vector, no /Alt available in the engine).

align.description: Horizontal placement inside the content width.

data.description: Raw payload to encode — do NOT URL-encode. For QR/URL pass e.g. "https://example.com" verbatim. EAN-13 must be 12 or 13 digits (13th is auto-computed). Code 128 accepts ASCII alphanumerics.

ecLevel.description: QR ONLY. Error correction level (L=7%, M=15%, Q=25%, H=30%). Ignored for code128/ean13/datamatrix/pdf417. Use H for printed media that may get smudged or partially covered (e.g. logo overlay).

height.description: Barcode height in PDF points (ignored for square symbologies like QR/Data Matrix).

oneOf.description: Vector drawing from an SVG path `d` string or SVG markup. Supported: <path> <rect> (rx/ry) <circle> <ellipse> <line> <polyline> <polygon> and <text>/<tspan> (x, y, font-size, fill, text-anchor, dx/dy); fill / stroke / stroke-width attributes; double-quoted attributes only. NOT supported (silently ignored): transform, <g>, <use>, <image>, <defs>/<clipPath>, gradients, opacity, CSS/style, dash patterns, text word-wrap. No external reference is ever fetched (no XML parser: entities other than & < > " '   &#n; are dropped). Pure path operators — PDF/A-safe at every level.

align.description: Horizontal placement inside the content width.

alt.description: Accessible description (tagged /Figure /Alt). Always provide it for non-decorative content under PDF/A or PDF/UA.

data.description: Path `d` string or SVG markup (≤ 100 000 characters).

anyOf.description: DeviceCMYK operands 'C M Y K', each 0.0–1.0.
DeviceCMYK ink percentages [c, m, y, k], each 0–100.
DeviceCMYK operands 'C M Y K', each 0.0–1.0.
DeviceCMYK ink percentages [c, m, y, k], each 0–100.

strokeWidth.description: Stroke width in SVG user units (default 1).

viewBox.description: [minX, minY, width, height] — overrides the viewBox of the markup; required for a bare path string that is not 0-based.

oneOf.description: Inline AcroForm field — same body as an add_form field. Under a PDF/A claim pass embedFonts:true so the field font is embedded too (PDFA_UNEMBEDDED_FORM_FONT otherwise; strict:true then fails the call).

checked.description: Initial checked state for checkbox / radio fields.

fieldType.description: Type of form control to render. Radio fields sharing a name form one radio group.

fontSize.description: Font size for text rendering inside the field.

height.description: Field height in points (default depends on the type).

label.description: Human-readable label shown above the field.

maxLength.description: Maximum character length for text/textarea fields.

name.description: Unique field name used as the PDF annotation identifier (/T).

options.description: Choices for dropdown, listbox or radio fields.

placeholder.description: Hint text shown while the field is empty.

value.description: Pre-filled value. The key is 'value' (there is no defaultValue).

width.description: Field width in points (default: full content width).

embedFonts.description: Measure with the embedded Noto Sans Latin metrics instead of Helvetica — pass the same value you will give generate_basic_pdf. (Embed Noto Sans Latin instead of the viewer base-14 Helvetica. REQUIRED for a valid PDF/A or PDF/X claim (every font embedded) and for strict=true; adds ~0.3 MiB.)

fields.description: Optional dot-path projection applied to the structured result (e.g. ['totalPages'] or ['pages.blocks.type']). Composes after verbosity. Unknown paths are omitted.

footerTemplate.description: Running footer on every page. Replaces the default footer: footerText is then ignored and page numbers appear only via {page}/{pages}.

center.description: Placeholders: {page} {pages} {title} {date} (UTC date of creationDate when pinned, else of the build).

right.description: Placeholders: {page} {pages} {title} {date} (UTC date of creationDate when pinned, else of the build).

footerText.description: Footer text as you would pass it to generate_basic_pdf (reserves the footer band).

headerTemplate.description: Running header on every page (left / center / right zones); reserves 15 pt.

center.description: Placeholders: {page} {pages} {title} {date} (UTC date of creationDate when pinned, else of the build).

DeviceCMYK ink percentages [c, m, y, k], each 0–100.

left.description: Placeholders: {page} {pages} {title} {date} (UTC date of creationDate when pinned, else of the build).

right.description: Placeholders: {page} {pages} {title} {date} (UTC date of creationDate when pinned, else of the build).

margins.description: Margins in points, all four required (0–200). Default 45 / 36 / 35 / 36.

normalize.description: Unicode normalization before shaping ('NFC' recommended for glyph coverage; NFD/NFKC/NFKD accepted). Omit = none.

pageSize.description: Portrait page preset (points): A4 595.28×841.89 (default), Letter 612×792, Legal 612×1008, A3 841.89×1190.55, Tabloid 792×1224. print.* boxes must fit it.

pdfA.description: Tagged (PDF/A) layout mode, as you would pass it to generate_basic_pdf. PDF/A level: pdfa1b (simple text+images), pdfa2b/pdfa2u (richer; 2u = Unicode mapping), pdfa3b (attachments / Factur-X). Pair with embedFonts=true for a valid claim. Exclusive with encryption. See docs/guides/PDFA.md.

title.description: Document title — reserves the title band on page 1 exactly as generate_basic_pdf does.

typography.description: Fine typography, all opt-in (omitted = unchanged bytes). kerning, fontFeatures and the 'fr' narrow space need embedFonts:true. No hyphenation dictionary is installed: use soft hyphens (U+00AD). See the typography prompt.

bindShortWords.description: Never end a line on a short word: up to maxLength letters (default 1), or exactly the listed words.

fontFeatures.description: OpenType features, later wins. tnum / lnum are no-ops on Noto Sans (TYPOGRAPHY_FEATURE_INEFFECTIVE).

hyphenationLanguage.description: BCP 47 tag; no effect here (no hyphenation provider installed).

keepHeadingsWithNext.description: Never strand a heading at a page foot. true = { minLines: 2 }.

metrics.description: Base-14 text: 'exact' uses the AFM widths (different wraps). Default 'approximate'.

opticalMargins.description: Hang punctuation into the margin of align:'justify' text.

orphans.description: Min lines left at a page foot (default 2; needs splitParagraphs).

punctuationSpacing.description: No-break spaces next to punctuation (existing spaces only). 'fr': narrow before ; ! ?, no-break before ':' and inside « ». 'fr-CA': ':' and « » only. Or explicit rules.

splitParagraphs.description: Paragraphs may break across pages at a line boundary (default: atomic).

unitBinding.description: No-break space between a number and its unit ('150 €', '12 kg'); units replaces the built-in list.

widows.description: Min lines carried over (default 2; needs splitParagraphs).

verbosity.description: 'full' (default) or 'summary' (scalars only: pageWidth, pageHeight, totalPages, blockCount; pages[] and margins dropped).

name: inspect_layout

outputSchema.description: Structured layout preview. Every property is optional because the result can be projected: verbosity:'summary' returns only the scalar summary fields, fields:[...] keeps a dot-path subset. Defaults return the full shape.

blockCount.description: summary only: number of placed blocks (table slices count once each).

margins.description: Page margins { top, right, bottom, left } in points.

pages.description: Per-page block placement, in render order. A table that spans pages appears once per slice.

page.description: 0-based page index the block was placed on.

top.description: Top edge in points, y increasing upward (PDF user space).

type.description: The originating block's type (heading, paragraph, table, …).

width.description: Content width available to the block in points.

totalPages.description: Number of pages the blocks paginate into.
